title: Rasmus' Seed Search & Tweaks
description:
[h2]Find the seed you want, before you start the run.[/h2]
Adds a [b]Search Seed[/b] button to the Custom Run screen (singleplayer). It opens a full screen where you pick what you want from the game's own icons, and the mod searches millions of seeds per second for it.

[h3]Filter by[/h3]
[list]
[*]Neow's offers, and what they give when you take them
[*]Which act you get, and its boss and ancient
[*]The order of events, fights and elites
[*]The order relics come in
[*]Elites, rests, shops and unknowns on the map
[*]The first card reward and potion
[/list]

[h3]Preview any seed[/h3]
Neow's three offers and their outcomes, the first fight reward, every act's boss, ancient, events and fights, the relic bags, and the act maps.

[h3]Keep what you find[/h3]
Bookmark seeds with a note, and come back to recent or kept searches. One click puts a seed into the Custom Run screen.

[h3]Card tweak[/h3]
Master Planner costs 1 less energy: 1, and 0 when upgraded.

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changes gameplay, so everyone in a multiplayer lobby needs the mod.
[*]The fast search is Windows only; other platforms use a slower search.
[*]Built for game version 0.111.0. A game update can break it until the mod is updated.
[*]No dependencies.
[/list]

Unofficial fan-made mod, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
changeNote: v1.3.0: seed search on the Custom Run screen, with bookmarks and saved searches.
